title: gamrnd

gpu_support.notes: RunMat currently generates samples on the host RNG path and restores documented floating gpuArray output to the input provider.

description: `gamrnd(a,b)` generates gamma random samples with shape parameter `a` and scale parameter `b`. Size-vector and dimension-list forms are supported.
behaviors: `a` and `b` support scalar expansion and matching array shapes.
Without explicit size arguments, the output shape is the scalar-expanded parameter shape.
With explicit size arguments, nonscalar parameters must match the requested shape.
`a` must be nonnegative and `b` must be positive.

MATLAB-compatible mode accepts documented single and double parameters and size controls. Native typed-integer parameters or dimensions are separately declared RunMat extensions; admitted numerical parameters must be exactly representable at the binary64 sampling boundary.
Automatic internal residency may gather transparently. Documented explicit floating gpuArray input preserves its provider ownership and output residency.

faqs.question: Which RNG does gamrnd use?
faqs.answer: It uses RunMat's shared deterministic RNG state, so `rng('default')` resets subsequent `gamrnd` output.
